snippet.title: Kill The Shadow - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Kill The Shadow will be released on 5 August 2026 for PC.
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2660230/Kill_The_Shadow/

In an alternate post-war divided city, players take on the role of Detective Lucas. Use your eloquence, intelligence, the ability to rewind time (or even violence) to investigate and deduce various bizarre cases, unraveling a shocking secret behind them. Justice or love? The decision is yours. 

Developer: Shadowlight
X: https://x.com/KilltheShadow_
